name: Code Sandbox
description: Files and folders in your workspace, and an network-isolated sandbox to write and run code.
abilities: Creates, reads and changes files and folders in your workspace
Runs Python and shell scripts in an network-isolated sandbox
Clones public Git repositories to read
Moves files between your Workspace files and its workspace: opens what you attach or receive, and sends you what it makes
Unpacks and packs archives (ZIP, tar.gz, RAR, 7z and more) safely, in the sandbox: nothing leaves the folder and nothing runs
permissions: Works only in your own private workspace, with no network while code runs
Asks before deleting files, and before changing them once it has read outside content

changes.notes: Clarifies server-side network isolation and adds strictly read-only workspace inspection.
Files you attach or receive can be opened in its workspace, and what it makes sent to you; archives unpacked and packed safely.
Now a plugin in the Store, on for everyone. Turn it off here when you don't want it.
